description: This file defines the EmbeddedURLForVimeo class which extends AbstractBuzzVideoURL. The class provides functionality to generate an embedded Vimeo video URL from various Vimeo URL formats, including validating and extracting the Vimeo ID.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForVimeo
classes.description: A class that constructs an embedded Vimeo URL from a given Vimeo URL, validating the URL format and extracting the video ID.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded video URL if the current URL is a valid Vimeo URL, otherwise throws an exception.
